english.title: Exceed the 30 / 40 / 50 mph speed limit on the approaches to the Kingsway Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle. namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the approaches to the Kingsway Tunnels at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) exceeded the maximum permitted speed of

(A)_[40 miles per hour on the tunnels' approach road situated between the tunnels and the bridge carrying Mill Lane over the tunnels' approach road in the Wallasey District of the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral in contravention of Byelaw 4(d)(i)]_
(B)_[50 miles per hour on the tunnels' approaches in the Wallasey District of the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral in contravention of Byelaw 4(d)(ii)]_
(C)_[40 miles per hour on the tunnels' approach road situated between the tunnels and the bridge carrying Scotland Road over the tunnels' approach road in the City of Liverpool in contravention of Byelaw 4(d)(iii)]_
(D)_[30 miles per hour in the tunnels' approaches in the City of Liverpool in contravention of Byelaw 4(d)(iv)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 4(d) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
